name: Verdra
notes: The only place colour values live (Master Build Plan 5). Code reads tokens by name. Section 5 and 6 of the plan win over the brand system when they differ. Colour, spacing, radius and shadow values match the design system's tokens.json version 3; motion, layout and border tokens come from plan section 6 (plan 16.2, M0 decisions).

tokens.name: brand-canopy
tokens.usage: Deepest brand green. Logo leaves on light grounds, the app-icon tile, cover blocks. Never body text colour on dark grounds.

tokens.name: brand-verdigris
tokens.usage: Core brand green. Logo node on light grounds. In the UI it appears through `primary` (light theme).

tokens.name: brand-sprout
tokens.usage: Bright brand green. Logo node on dark grounds. In the UI it appears through `primary` (dark theme). Fails as text on light grounds (1.8:1).

tokens.name: brand-mist
tokens.usage: Pale brand tint. Logo leaves on dark grounds, `primary-tint` in the light theme.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window background behind panels and lists.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, dialogs, table rows.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating cards, menus, popovers, toasts and dialogs; pairs with `shadow-raised` or `shadow-overlay`. `ink` reads 16.8:1 light, 12.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset areas: text fields, code and asset-ID wells, the track of a progress bar.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `primary-tint` (14:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholders on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-sunken` (6.3:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Text and icons of disabled controls only, always with a tooltip saying why. Exempt from text contrast under WCAG; never for live text.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and sections. Not for control borders (below 3:1).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, switches and unselected checkboxes; 3.3:1 or better on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes (dark 3.3:1 on `surface-raised`).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, the selected state, the switch when on. Text in `primary` reads on `bg` and `surface` (5.6:1 light, 8.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary buttons.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for primary buttons. `on-primary` reads 9.5:1 light, 12.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` or `primary-hover` fill (6:1 light, 9.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the Cosmetic risk badge, hover wash on list items. Put `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard-focus outline with 2px offset. 5:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: tooltip-bg
tokens.usage: Tooltip background (inverted ground).

tokens.name: tooltip-ink
tokens.usage: Tooltip text on `tooltip-bg` (15.7:1 light, 15.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modal dialogs.

tokens.name: palette-shadow
tokens.usage: QPalette Shadow role (Master plan 5.6). Not for drawn shadows; those use shadow-raised and shadow-overlay.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Healthy or finished states (Routing, Applied). Deliberately cyan rather than green, so it never relies on red versus green against `danger`. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success notices. Text on it uses `success-ink`.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `success-tint` (7.8:1 light, 8.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Degraded states, the Account-sensitive risk badge. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warning notices and badges. Text on it uses `warning-ink`.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `warning-tint` (7.7:1 light, 8.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, the Moderation-risk badge. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of error notices and badges. Text on it uses `danger-ink`.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `danger-tint` (7.5:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Splash screen, About window and marketing only. Stand-in face until the custom display face is added.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, timestamps, secondary metadata. Use `ink-muted`.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels and badge text. Never for sentences.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Asset IDs, hashes, file paths, FastFlag names. Use `tabular-nums` alignment in tables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; compact row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in a tab.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, gap before a page's first section.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large gaps in empty states and onboarding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap above an empty state's illustration.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges, checkboxes, table focus cells.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, notices, menus.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the app-icon tile (14 of 64).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switches, status pills, progress bars.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Every border.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring width.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Focus ring offset.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards that float over `bg`. Most panels use a `divider` border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts.

tokens.name: instant
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: quick
tokens.usage: Switches, checkboxes, tab and screen changes.

tokens.name: settle
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts, panels entering.

tokens.name: grow
tokens.usage: Progress fills, expanding sections.

tokens.name: bloom
tokens.usage: Splash logo only.

exit.usage: Exits use this easing at two-thirds of the entry duration.

reduced.usage: With reduced motion every movement becomes a fade of up to 150 ms.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Table rows (comfortable density).

tokens.name: row-height-compact
tokens.usage: Table rows (compact density).

tokens.name: row-height-two-line
tokens.usage: List rows with two lines.

tokens.name: hit-target-icon
tokens.usage: Minimum icon-button size.

tokens.name: hit-target-text
tokens.usage: Minimum text-button height.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-width-collapsed
tokens.usage: Icons-only sidebar.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Window header.
